text:
maria: Heads-up: Ops wants to tighten `backup-agent` assume-role to require `tag:env=prod`. That will affect our tenant restore path which does a cross-account assume. Need quick risk triage + canary runbook.
az: do we change key policy or only IAM assume conditions? canary plan depends on which.
laura: only IAM assume condition. But remember, cross-account roles don't carry tags unless the principal has them. Many SAML-assumed roles we use won't match.
maria: saw a restore failure in perf staging yesterday; paste below. Not sure root cause was assume vs kms grant.
```text
2026-02-10T08:42:11Z restore-runner ERROR restore failed: AssumeRoleDenied: arn:aws:iam::210987654321:role/tenant-restore-service -> sts:AssumeRole denied
2026-02-10T08:42:12Z restore-runner ERROR decrypt failed: KMS AccessDeniedException for key arn:aws:kms:us-west-2:123456789012:key/abcd-ef01
```
oz: two separate checks: (A) sts:AssumeRole DENY, (B) KMS Decrypt DENY. We need detection for both and pre-seeded mitigations.
laura: proposal: 1) create a small canary window 30m off-hours; 2) create allowlist role bindings for three critical cross-acct ARNs; 3) pre-create an explicit KMS grant for the `backup-agent` role and the tenant-restore-service for the canary period (so decryption works even if role mapping surprises us); 4) run 3 restores (same-account, cross-account, cross-region).
sec-robot: checklist automation suggestions: verify assume success via CloudTrail eventName=AssumeRole with errorCode=null, verify Decrypt event for key with requesterPrincipalId matches role ARN. Alert if either fails.
maria: exact policy diff we plan to apply:
```json
- "Statement": [{ "Action": "sts:AssumeRole", "Resource": "arn:aws:iam::123456789012:role/backup-agent" }]
+ "Statement": [{ "Action": "sts:AssumeRole", "Resource": "arn:aws:iam::123456789012:role/backup-agent", "Condition": { "StringEquals": { "aws:RequestTag/env": "prod" }}}]
```
oz: that RequestTag condition will break existing cross-account assume flows unless callers send RequestTag or principals have matching tags.
laura: mitigation options: A) add explicit allowlist for known ARNs, B) during canary temporarily add resource-based KMS grants for the tenant restore role. C) fallback: feature flag to skip RBAC change if restore errors spike.
maria: I'm for allowlist + prestaged KMS grant. Can you paste the grant command we'll run?
laura: grant (example):
```bash
aws kms create-grant --key-id alias/rd-backups --grantee-principal arn:aws:iam::210987654321:role/tenant-restore-service --operations Decrypt --name "canary-restore-grant"
```
oz: and detection queries. CloudTrail quick lookup:
```bash
aws cloudtrail lookup-events --lookup-attributes AttributeKey=EventName,AttributeValue=AssumeRole --start-time 2026-02-10T00:00:00Z
```
OpenSearch (pseudo):
```sql
SELECT eventTime, userIdentity.arn, eventName, errorCode
FROM cloudtrail_events
WHERE (eventName = 'AssumeRole' AND errorCode IS NOT NULL)
   OR (eventName = 'Decrypt' AND errorCode LIKE '%AccessDenied%')
ORDER BY eventTime DESC
LIMIT 50
```
sec-robot: alerting: create two CloudWatch metric filters -> (1) count AssumeRole failures for backup-agent resource, (2) count KMS AccessDenied for alias/rd-backups. Pager if counts > 1 within 10m. Canary abort criteria: >20% restore failures or any customer-facing restore timeout.
pagerduty: I'll add oncall list: sec-oncall, infra-oncall, platform-lead. Include rollback runbook.
maria: rollback plan: 1) revert IAM assume condition; 2) revoke canary KMS grants; 3) post-mortem and re-evaluate tag rollout.
laura: I'll generate a simulate-principal run against the three ARNs to confirm assume behaviour before change:
```bash
aws iam simulate-principal-policy --policy-source-arn arn:aws:iam::123456789012:role/backup-agent --action-names sts:AssumeRole --resource-arns arn:aws:iam::210987654321:role/tenant-restore-service
```
oz: also recommend we run a small synthetic restore that verifies post-decrypt data integrity (check checksums) not just success flag.
maria: timeline: staging canary tomorrow 03:00 UTC, production window Thu 02:00 UTC with 30m canary. I'll push CHG and attach this thread. Owners: laura runs grants + scripts, oz sets alerts/dashboards, maria will coordinate change and rollback.
laura: I'll post logs after the staging canary.
sec-robot: remember to tag the KMS grant resource with `temporary=true` and an expiry annotation.
pagerduty: change scheduled CHG-20260211-77. Notifying channel 15m prior.
maria: thanks team. will update ticket with key ARNs and test results.
